summary: Iteration 65: STOREFRONT_PER_COMPANY=true (flag-ON) end-to-end verification against LIVE prod (SAFE MODE). Backend 13/13 pytest PASS: profile reads for company 1 (hostbay) and company 62 (KLOSE) return company-scoped fields with NO storefront_pending; public /api/shop/hostbay + /api/pay/creator/hostbay both 200; PUT profile under X-Company-Id:62 with {handle:'hostbay'} correctly returns 409; KLOSE claim of 'klose-qa-8x3' succeeds (200), immediately public GET /api/pay/creator/klose-qa-8x3 → 200 with KLOSE identity, and hostbay stays isolated (200, no leakage of klose-qa-8x3); analytics/split shows both companies with correct handles + hostbay's real 30d data (views=31, tips_amount=10, tips_count=1); products endpoint returns 200 for both companies; tax + wallet regression PASS. Frontend Playwright PASS with ONE UI BUG found: the storefront status banner ([data-testid='creator-status-banner']) displays scoped-shop.preview.emergentagent.com/hostbay under BOTH company contexts — even under KLOSE (where every other UI element correctly shows klose-qa-8x3: page title 'Editing KLOSE's storefront', 'Your public page' URL, Share tab URL, QR, Live Preview, handle input). The banner appears to still read the user-level (primary company) handle instead of the flag-ON per-company handle. Public /hostbay renders the creator page correctly (title 'hostbay (@hostbay) · Dynopay', supporters/tips visible). Zero console errors on /storefront (both contexts) and /hostbay. Compare panel renders under KLOSE. Session restored to last_company_id='1'.

ui_bugs.issue: Status banner shows the primary-company handle URL (scoped-shop.preview.emergentagent.com/hostbay) even when the active company context is KLOSE with its own handle 'klose-qa-8x3'. All other UI elements on the same page (title 'Editing KLOSE's storefront', 'Your public page' row, Share tab URL, QR link, Live Preview, creator-handle-input value) correctly use klose-qa-8x3. The banner is not consuming the flag-ON per-company profile — likely reading from the user-level (primary) creator profile.

rca of the issue: CreatorStatusBanner banner-URL bug: Under STOREFRONT_PER_COMPANY=true, GET /api/user/creator/profile correctly returns the company-scoped handle (hostbay for co=1, klose-qa-8x3 for co=62). The frontend Share tab and creator-handle-input consume this API. However, the top status banner (data-testid='creator-status-banner' in Components/Page/Storefront/PageTab.tsx or CreatorStatusBanner) still binds its URL to the user-level/primary handle (probably from an older useUser or /api/user/profile source that predates the per-company flag). Fix: switch the banner to read handle/URL from the same useStorefrontProfile / getCreatorProfileSettings response that already drives the surrounding tiles. Reproduction: login as hostbay@moxx.co, switch to KLOSE (localStorage.last_company_id='62' + reload), open /storefront — banner reads '.../hostbay' while page title says 'Editing KLOSE' and Share tab reads '.../klose-qa-8x3'.
